digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite / CI workflows
propositions: The external integration suite currently runs live tests against only one provider (Anthropic) despite rebar supporting multiple credentialed providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI), leaving provider-specific regressions undetected by CI

Provider selection must be a matrix dimension in the CI workflows rather than an ambient default, with each arm selecting its provider via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE to override only [llm.model_classes] and deep-merge over discovered config

The Bedrock arm must obtain credentials via OIDC role assumption to a dedicated scoped IAM role (not EC2 instance role) with explicit region resolution (AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION), and must fail loudly rather than skip silently when credentials or region are absent
Each CI arm whose credential is absent must skip loudly and be distinguishable from passing runs, never reading as a vacuous green

Config overlays that set only [llm.model_classes] must not leave the ambient default model (cfg.model) pointing to Anthropic, and tests must verify both class selection and ambient default resolution per provider
